## Kevin's Test Suite

### Happy Path Tests (Me Like These)

1. **TestProcessPayment_Success** - Card works, money goes in. Simple. Like cookie.
2. **TestProcessPayment_CompletedStatusSet** - Status says "completed" when done. Good status.
3. **TestRefundPayment_FullRefund** - All money comes back. Sad but works.
4. **TestRefundPayment_PartialRefund** - Some money comes back. Math involved.
5. **TestGetPayment_Success** - Get payment by ID. Like finding cookie in jar.

### Amount Tests (Numbers! My... thing)

6. **TestProcessPayment_InvalidAmount_Zero** - Zero cents not allowed. Makes sense.
7. **TestProcessPayment_InvalidAmount_Negative** - Negative money? That's just... owing.
8. **TestProcessPayment_InvalidAmount_ExceedsMaximum** - Over $100,000. Big number. Too big.
9. **TestProcessPayment_ValidAmount_OneCent** - Smallest money. Still money.
10. **TestProcessPayment_ValidAmount_MaxBoundary** - Exactly $100,000. Right on line.

### Card Expired Tests

11. **TestProcessPayment_CardExpired_PastYear** - Old card. No work.
12. **TestProcessPayment_CardExpired_PastMonthCurrentYear** - Same year, old month. Tricky but bad.
13. **TestProcessPayment_CardValid_CurrentMonth** - This month okay. Good card.
14. **TestProcessPayment_CardValid_FutureDate** - Future card. Time travel works.

### Error Tests (When Things Go Boom)

15. **TestProcessPayment_CardDeclined** - Gateway says no. Card bad.
16. **TestProcessPayment_GatewayError** - Gateway breaks. Not card's fault.
17. **TestProcessPayment_StoreSaveError** - Can't save. Very bad.
18. **TestProcessPayment_StoreUpdateErrorAfterCharge** - Money taken but update fail. VERY bad. Critical.
19. **TestRefundPayment_GatewayRefundError** - Refund breaks at gateway.
20. **TestRefundPayment_StoreUpdateErrorAfterRefund** - Refund works but can't save. Also bad.

### Idempotency (Big Word. Me Looked Up)

21. **TestProcessPayment_IdempotencyKey_ReturnsSamePayment** - Same key, same payment back. No double charge.
22. **TestProcessPayment_IdempotencyKey_Empty** - No key, no check. Just process.
23. **TestProcessPayment_IdempotencyKey_DifferentKeys** - Different key, different payment.
24. **TestProcessPayment_IdempotencyKey_ConcurrentRequests** - Two at once, same key. Only one wins.

### Rate Limiter Tests

25. **TestProcessPayment_RateLimitExceeded** - Too fast. Slow down.
26. **TestProcessPayment_RateLimitAllowed** - Normal speed. Okay.

### Refund Edge Cases

27. **TestRefundPayment_NotFound** - Payment doesn't exist. Can't refund air.
28. **TestRefundPayment_StatusPending** - Can't refund pending. Wait first.
29. **TestRefundPayment_StatusFailed** - Can't refund failed. Nothing to refund.
30. **TestRefundPayment_StatusAlreadyFullyRefunded** - Already refunded. No double refund.
31. **TestRefundPayment_ExceedsRemainingAmount** - Too much refund. Math wrong.
32. **TestRefundPayment_MultiplePartialRefunds** - Refund, refund, refund. Track total.
33. **TestRefundPayment_ExactRemainingAmount** - Last bit of money. Becomes full refund.

### Concurrency Tests (Scary)

34. **TestProcessPayment_ConcurrentDifferentCustomers** - Many people, all work.
35. **TestIdempotencyMap_ConcurrentReadWrite** - Many goroutines, one map. Mutex helps.

### Card Number Handling

36. **TestProcessPayment_CardNumberLastFourStored** - Only keeps last 4. Security good.
37. **TestProcessPayment_CardNumberTooShort** - Card number less than 4... panic? (Bug maybe)

### Metadata Tests

38. **TestProcessPayment_MetadataPreserved** - Metadata goes in, stays in.
39. **TestProcessPayment_ChargeIDStoredInMetadata** - charge_id saved after success.
